title: Work of the almost-wise construction
statement: For an input $I$ consisting of integers $k,n,a,b$ with $1\le k\le n$, $0<a$, and $2a\le b$, the construction work is the sum of the executable Vandermonde construction work for $k,n$, the deterministic small-bias work for the small-bias input associated with $I$, and the binary-constructor traversal work evaluated at the executable matrix-vector multiplication work for the row count and $n$, increased by one, and the number of outputs of the deterministic small-bias algorithm for that input.
caveat: The supplied snippet uses fields and work measures not defined there, including the small-bias input, row count, and associated construction functions, so their meanings cannot be stated self-containedly from the provided definitions.
